## 流体力学・検証問題 {#fluid-dynamics}

### 準一次元ノズル

NASA Glenn Research Center

- [NASA の等エントロピー関係（ドキュメント）](https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/k-12/airplane/isentrop.html)
- [NASA CDVノズル検証ケース（ドキュメント）](https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/wind/valid/cdv/cdv.html)
- [NASA CDVの軸方向Mach数データ（データ）](https://www.grc.nasa.gov/www/wind/valid/cdv/axial.Mex.p16.gen)

### 浅水方程式・ダム崩壊

- Olivier Delestre・Carine Lucas・Pierre-Antoine Ksinant・Frédéric Darboux・Christian Laguerre・T.-N.-Tuoi Vo・François James・Stéphane Cordier, [SWASHES: a compilation of shallow water analytic solutions for hydraulic and environmental studies](https://doi.org/10.1002/fld.3741), *International Journal for Numerical Methods in Fluids*, 72(3), 269–300 (2013).

### 非圧縮性Navier–Stokes方程式

- E. Shirani・J. H. Ferziger・W. C. Reynolds, [Mixing of a passive scalar in isotropic and sheared homogeneous turbulence](https://ntrs.nasa.gov/citations/19820003521), NASA Contractor Report NASA-CR-164938 / SU-TF-15 (1981).
- Akio Arakawa, [Computational design for long-term numerical integration of the equations of fluid motion: Two-dimensional incompressible flow. Part I](https://doi.org/10.1016/0021-9991%2866%2990015-5), *Journal of Computational Physics*, 1(1), 119–143 (1966).
- U. Ghia・K. N. Ghia・C. T. Shin, [High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier–Stokes equations and a multigrid method](https://doi.org/10.1016/0021-9991%2882%2990058-4), *Journal of Computational Physics*, 48(3), 387–411 (1982).

### 円柱まわり流れ

- O. Posdziech・R. Grundmann, [A systematic approach to the numerical calculation of fundamental quantities of the two-dimensional flow over a circular cylinder](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfluidstructs.2006.09.004), *Journal of Fluids and Structures*, 23(3), 479–499 (2007).
- Gabriel D. Weymouth・Bernat Font, [WaterLily.jl: A differentiable and backend-agnostic Julia solver for incompressible viscous flow around dynamic bodies](https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cpc.2025.109748), *Computer Physics Communications*, 315, 109748 (2025).

### 衝撃波管・Riemann問題

- Eleuterio F. Toro, [Riemann Solvers and Numerical Methods for Fluid Dynamics: A Practical Introduction](https://doi.org/10.1007/b79761), 第3版, Springer, 2009.
- David I. Ketcheson・Randall J. LeVeque・Mauricio J. del Razo, [Riemann Problems and Jupyter Solutions: Theory and Approximate Solvers for Hyperbolic PDEs](https://www.clawpack.org/riemann_book/), SIAM, 2020.
- [`riemann_book`の `exact_solvers/euler.py`（実装例）](https://github.com/clawpack/riemann_book/blob/5b171f11fd7a3e810ee7a74a4d9f2dff01d65a6e/exact_solvers/euler.py)

### 水平対流

- Ali Ramadhan・Gregory LeClaire Wagner・Chris Hill・Jean-Michel Campin・Valentin Churavy・Tim Besard・Andre Souza・Alan Edelman・Raffaele Ferrari・John Marshall, [Oceananigans.jl: Fast and friendly geophysical fluid dynamics on GPUs](https://doi.org/10.21105/joss.02018), *Journal of Open Source Software*, 5(53), 2018 (2020).
- Cesar B. Rocha・Navid C. Constantinou・Stefan G. Llewellyn Smith・William R. Young, [The Nusselt numbers of horizontal convection](https://doi.org/10.1017/jfm.2020.269), *Journal of Fluid Mechanics*, 894, A24 (2020).

## 熱伝導・相変化・逆問題 {#heat-transfer}

### Stefan問題・相変化

- Nahuel Caruso・Sabrina Roscani・Lucas Venturato・Vaughan Voller, [Computation of Prefactor of Free Boundary in One Dimensional One-Phase Fractional Stefan Problems](https://doi.org/10.3390/fractalfract9070397), *Fractal and Fractional*, 9(7), 397 (2025).
- V. R. Voller・M. Cross・N. C. Markatos, [An enthalpy method for convection/diffusion phase change](https://doi.org/10.1002/nme.1620240119), *International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering*, 24(1), 271–284 (1987).

### 自然対流キャビティ

- G. de Vahl Davis, [Natural convection of air in a square cavity: A bench mark numerical solution](https://doi.org/10.1002/fld.1650030305), *International Journal for Numerical Methods in Fluids*, 3(3), 249–264 (1983).

### 熱源推定・数値検証

- [DOLFINx：Poisson方程式の実装例（ドキュメント）](https://docs.fenicsproject.org/dolfinx/main/python/demos/demo_poisson.html) — FEniCS / DOLFINx開発チーム
- [MOOSE：Method of Manufactured Solutions（ドキュメント）](https://mooseframework.inl.gov/moose/getting_started/examples_and_tutorials/tutorial03_verification/step04_mms.html) — MOOSE開発チーム
- Armand Wirgin, [The inverse crime](https://arxiv.org/abs/math-ph/0401050), arXiv:math-ph/0401050 (2004).
- A. Raue・C. Kreutz・T. Maiwald・J. Bachmann・M. Schilling・U. Klingmüller・J. Timmer, [Structural and practical identifiability analysis of partially observed dynamical models by exploiting the profile likelihood](https://doi.org/10.1093/BIOINFORMATICS/BTP358), *Bioinformatics*, 25(15), 1923–1929 (2009).
- Axel Flinth・Ali Hashemi, [Thermal Source Localization Through Infinite-Dimensional Compressed Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/1710.02016), arXiv:1710.02016 (2017).
